Held GET /pause-state can then refresh terminal receipts but may conditionalcancel other unreleased rows or persist UNKNOWN. No arbitrary target-key parameter in selected routing.
POST /resume /microphone /pause-revalidate are controls/recovery, not a running read-only receipt refresh.
